description:
01:35 Is the church in apostasy? Desmond Ford was removed for heresy, but others preach the same—why are they still in the church?

12:50 Do Last Generation Theology teachings deny the sufficiency of Christ’s sacrifice, as critics say?

Welcome to I’d Like to Know, a Bible Q&A program on SUMtv, featuring Seventh-day Adventist pastors, including Pastor Stephen Bohr, President of SUMtv, Pastor David Salazar, Pastor CA Murray and Pastor Daniel Miranda. In each episode, we dive into the Scriptures to provide clear, biblically-based answers to your questions, offering spiritual guidance and practical wisdom that align with the teachings of the Adventist Church. Tune in for insights that will help deepen your understanding of God’s Word and prepare for Christ's soon return.

🙏✨ Send us your questions at tv@sumtv.org, and they might be featured in an upcoming episode!

⏰ Join Us Live Every Tuesday at 4:30 PM (Pacific Time)
Tune in to SUMtv.org for our live studio Q&A, where we explore the Bible and answer your questions with the spirit of prophecy and truth!

🔎 Want to Go Deeper?
Explore in-depth Bible studies and spiritual resources at SecretsUnsealed.org.

📺 Watch Uplifting Content 24/7
